categories.main_business_segments: Genew Technologies primarily operates in the telecommunications equipment and solutions sector, focusing on core network systems, optical networks and access systems, intelligent networks and smart emergency systems, and technical and maintenance services. The company offers end-to-end 5G solutions including 5G core networks, IMS, RCS, UPF, and PON series products, serving both public networks and private networks across various industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as virtual operating system platforms, communication signaling and protocol stacks, cloud-based DSP technology, AI intelligent scheduling, heterogeneous network integration, and fully domestic communication equipment technology. It emphasizes software-hardware decoupling, cloud-native deployment, and proprietary innovations in satellite core networks, 5G voice technologies (VoNR), 5G messaging, and large-capacity 10G PON technology. Production mainly uses an outsourcing model with strict quality control and in-house core manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Genew serves telecommunications operators, government and enterprise private networks, energy, chemical, mining, and emergency management sectors. Key customers include major Chinese telecom operators such as China Telecom, China Unicom, China Mobile, and China Broadcasting Network, as well as overseas telecom operators in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Africa. The company also targets emerging markets in satellite internet and low-altitude economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with headquarters in Shenzhen and multiple subsidiaries across regions including East China, Northwest China, Southwest China, and South China. It has a significant overseas presence with wholly-owned or controlled subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Japan, Philippines, India, Middle East, Bangladesh, and other international markets, focusing on Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Genew operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the telecommunications supply chain, focusing on research and development, system design, sales, and after-sales technical services. It outsources manufacturing to qualified suppliers but retains control over core production processes such as product finalization, tooling design, assembly, and quality inspection.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in 5G and F5G technologies, satellite internet, and low-altitude economy applications. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on satellite core network technologies, 5G network and information security, 50G PON optical access, AIoT, and cloud-native network management. Genew actively participates in industry standardization and collaborates with global operators and research institutes to maintain technological leadership and expand product capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Genew generates revenue primarily through product sales of telecommunications equipment and systems, including core networks, optical networks, and smart emergency systems. It also earns income from technical services and maintenance contracts. The company engages in direct sales to telecom operators and enterprise customers, supplemented by long-term project contracts and overseas market expansion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major global telecom equipment providers such as Huawei, ZTE, Ericsson, and Nokia in the public network segment. However, Genew differentiates itself by focusing on niche markets like satellite internet core networks and customized private network solutions. It holds a leading position domestically in satellite core network technology and is a key partner for China Telecom's Tiantong-1 satellite network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Genew reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 951.7 million, a 7.6% increase year-over-year, and achieved net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 27.4 million, turning profitable after previous losses. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of over 20% of revenue and has steadily improved cash flow from operations. Total assets reached nearly RMB 1.95 billion, with net assets of RMB 906 million, reflecting a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Genew emphasizes its comprehensive end-to-end telecommunications solutions with strong proprietary technologies, especially in satellite core networks and fully domestic communication equipment. Its ability to provide customized, integrated solutions for both public and private networks, combined with high-quality service and a robust global sales network, offers customers reliable, secure, and innovative communication infrastructure. The company’s focus on cloud-native, software-hardware decoupled architectures and advanced 5G capabilities positions it as a competitive and forward-looking supplier.
